label: FutureMe
description: Mobile-first energy-aware planning companion centred on what the user should focus on next.

label: Monthly Setup
description: Setup flow where the user enters fixed commitments, sleep settings, routines, and capacity.

label: Fixed Commitments
description: Anchored events such as work, appointments, deadlines, social plans, and sleep.

label: Work Shifts
description: Work commitments that constrain schedule generation and recovery rules.

label: Appointments
description: Fixed appointments that should not be moved automatically.

label: Deadlines
description: Due dates or due-time anchors that influence daily focus.

label: Social Plans
description: Fixed or semi-fixed social commitments in the user's month.

label: Sleep Settings
description: Wake and bedtime anchors that prevent scheduling outside the user's day.

label: Flexible Activities
description: Routines FutureMe can place around fixed commitments.

label: Gym
description: Flexible activity scheduled mainly in the morning and reduced by lower capacity.

label: Cleaning
description: Flexible activity scheduled during daytime and reduced by essentials capacity.

label: Meal Prep
description: Flexible activity scheduled in afternoon/evening and preserved even in essentials capacity.

label: Food Shop
description: Flexible activity scheduled in realistic daytime/evening windows.

label: Self-care
description: Flexible care activity that increases during softer/essentials capacity.

label: Capacity Check
description: Energy/load state that influences routine frequency, pressure, and What’s Next recommendations.

label: Notification Vibe
description: User-selected tone for optional notification nudges.

label: Daily Dashboard
description: Primary product surface that shows what is next and what matters today.

label: What’s Next Engine
description: Central product logic for current task, next task, overdue work, recommendations, and nudges.

label: Active Task
description: Task currently needing attention.

label: Upcoming Task
description: Task scheduled soon but not currently active.

label: Overdue Task
description: Task whose planned time has passed without completion.

label: Completed Task
description: Task marked complete by the user.

label: Rescheduled Task
description: Task moved from its original scheduled slot.

label: Daily Focus
description: Main recommended focus for the user today or now.

label: Notification Nudge
description: Optional notification derived from schedule and What’s Next state.

label: Push Notifications
description: Web Push delivery system for optional reminder nudges.

label: Supabase
description: Database used for push subscriptions and scheduled reminders.

label: Vercel
description: Hosting and API route platform for FutureMe.

label: Service Worker
description: PWA worker supporting app shell caching and push notification events.

label: Scheduled Reminders
description: Supabase rows representing pending/sent/failed/cancelled reminder nudges.

label: Push Subscriptions
description: Supabase rows storing browser push endpoints and keys.

label: Scheduling Engine
description: Planner logic that generates monthly tasks from inputs, rules, and capacity.

label: Rules Engine
description: Constraints for realistic task placement and schedule quality.

label: Completion System
description: Task completion state used by the dashboard and future What’s Next Engine.

label: Night Shift Workflow
description: Safe review/report workflow for repo state, docs, bugs, tests, and next prompts.

label: Loop Engineering
description: Repeated focused improvement cycles with context, tests, summary, and next loop.
